name: Parity Longarm
description: Two crewmen load the counterweight box from either side in alternate shovels until the court captain finds it level.

name: Releasehook Largesse
description: Inspect both box hangers together by hand and eye so neither carries more of the weight than its twin.

name: Magnanimous Fulcrum
description: Turn the two winch cranks as a pair with opposite hands so the long arm descends without a sideways pull.

name: Pulsar Letgo
description: Release as both halves of the paired box settle together so the arm swings through without a trace of twist.

name: Peal Rigging
description: Let the two hangers swing out in a short whipping curve so the arm gains speed and the shot leaves harder.

name: Vigor Slingpouch
description: Count the winding in paired beats so each half of the crew meets the other at the notch.

name: Squall Swing
description: Both halves of the crew step back in mirrored paces as the box falls and clear its arc together.

name: Famed Shortarm
description: Drive the full fall of the loaded box through the arm into the shot to break the ward of a defended line.

name: Ironclad Longarm
description: Shape the crew's qi around the frame so the shock of a double-weighted release does not crack the sill.

name: Radiance Heaveoff
description: Join both halves of the court crew in one long winding so the loaded box throws a stone that shatters a great ward.

name: Unrivaled Pullrope
description: The court's school move in which both crews drop the paired box together so one stone falls with the combined qi of the court.

name: Reminiscence Tackle
description: Build a sighting post at the engine's flank where a spotter perches to call the fall from above.

name: Parityarm
description: Tilt the shot cradle upward with a wedge so the sling leaves the trough already climbing.

name: Pealtackle
description: Tie knots in a cord at each fall distance so the spotter can read the plunge angle by touch.

name: Pulsar Swing
description: Free the pin at the steep notch so the stone rises almost vertical before it turns to fall.

name: Tacklemercy
description: Take the spotter's call and move the notch one tooth so the next plunge lands on the mark.

name: Pulsartackle
description: Loose two stones so close in time that the second descends into the dust cloud of the first.

name: Steel Counterswing
description: Put qi into the stone at the top of its climb so it plunges through a canopy of shields.

name: Reminiscence Heaveoff
description: Throw stones into a dry field to raise a dust cloud that hides the engine and its next throw.

name: Vacuumarm
description: Wind the arm in stillness and loose one stone from so steep a climb that its fall gives no warning.

name: Radiance Letgo
description: The school's plunge in which the whole crew's qi drives the stone down as a single talon stroke on one point.

name: Vigorpulley
description: Dig a shallow trench along the engine line to carry rain away and keep the footing dry.

name: Interstice Releasehook
description: Run a survey rope along the engine line and mark each site so spacing is even from end to end.

name: Hospitable Releasehook
description: Pile shot in a ring behind each engine so crews fetch without crossing the line of the next.

name: Parity Releasehook
description: Paint each engine's number on a post so signals and reports name the right crew.

name: Heaveoff Triumph
description: Loose engines in order along the line so the fall of shot sweeps across the target front like a tide.

name: Magnanimous Ballast
description: Relay a spotter's correction down the line from crew to crew so all adjust within a few breaths.

name: Pealswing
description: Fire a ranging shot from each engine in turn to set the whole line's range with one volley of tests.

name: Bloomtackle
description: Close the gap in the engine line when a crew falls by moving the next crew to cover its beam.

name: Storied Overthrow
description: Grind a besieged place down with an unbroken fall of shot walked in measured steps across its defences.

name: Imperial Swing
description: Time the whole line's shots to fall on one block so their combined weight breaks every ward in it.

name: Thunderclap Letgo
description: Draw qi from every engine into one long winding and loose them in the same breath on one weak point.

name: Triumphant Bedrock Shortarm
description: The court's action in which the entire siege line fires on one drawn count so the target ground cannot be crossed.

name: Revelation Ballast
description: Drive ranging stakes at marked intervals along the field so every crew reads distance by eye.

name: Serene Hangcradle
description: Paint trial stones white so their landing marks stand out clearly on dark ground.

name: Bountiful Slingpouch
description: Plait a range cord of river reed with a knot at each set distance for the ranging crew.

name: Clement Hangcradle
description: Pass each correction along in a flowing chain so the engine's notch is reset before the next winding.

name: Inferno Counterswing
description: Throw one stone long and one short of the mark to bracket it then split the difference for the third.

name: Pulsararm
description: Prove the range of a fresh engine with one carefully loosed stone and note its notch for every crew.

name: Bountiful Tackle
description: Update the range card as the enemy moves so the engine never fires at the place he has left.

name: Splendid Swing
description: Send a ranged stone with qi in its core so it seeks the weakest point of a ward at its mark.

name: Volition Whiplash
description: Walk the fall of shot step by step across the enemy's line so no unit can stand its ground.

name: Vaunted Overthrow
description: Gather qi and the whole range card into one stone loosed at the last correction to strike exactly where the card says.

name: Illustrious Whiplash Edict
description: The court's throw in which every correction of the engine is made once so the single stone lands exactly on the mark.

name: Bloom Fulcrum
description: Raise the great beam on a timber gantry so its arm clears the highest throw.

name: Armgift
description: Raise the banner at the top of each winding stage so the crew sees the stage and answers.

name: Vigor Ballast
description: Band the great arm with brass at each joint to carry the strain of the heaviest throw.

name: Peal Longarm
description: Clear the sky above the engine of hanging banners and nesting birds before any great release.

name: Solar Releasehook
description: Wind the great beam in measured stages so the arm stands ready at its highest notch.

name: Thunderous Whiplash
description: Free the sling at the high notch so the stone climbs far into the azure before it falls.

name: Magnanimous Slingpouch
description: Both crews heave the winch in one voice so the great beam answers in a single stroke.

name: Inferno Shortarm
description: Release on the lowering of the azure banner so every hand loosens in the same breath.

name: Dauntless Heaveoff
description: Fill the shot with the combined qi of the crew so it breaks the high wards of a defended line.

name: Duneswing
description: Throw a mixed load into the high sky to fall as a rain of stone across a broad stretch.

name: Matchless Swing
description: Gather the whole court's qi through a very long winding to loose one great stone that falls on a single target.

name: Magmaswing
description: The court's stone driven by the whole crew's qi from the highest arc to break the ground and wards where it lands.

name: Bloomarm
description: Lay twin foundation beams under the engine so the force of a great release spreads across both tracks.

name: Eclipse Rigging
description: Pair spotters on the two tracks so each checks the other's call before the engine fires.

name: Eclipse Tackle
description: Load-test each haul rope against a full counterweight before a siege-ending throw.

name: Armtriumph
description: Throw two stones along the two tracks so each lands in a different place and the foe must guard both.

name: Prismswing
description: Throw a stone to hold an enemy sally back from the line so the engine's work is not interrupted.

name: Hangcradle Largesse
description: Switch from one track's bearing to the other in a single call and move the engine between them.

name: Thunderclap Releasehook
description: Drive core-deep qi through the shot so it breaks the ward on the keep of a besieged place.

name: Thrall Pullrope
description: Close both tracks of an enemy approach with falling stone so the force on them cannot go forward or back.

name: Vacuumletgo
description: Draw core qi from every hand into one winding and loose a stone that breaks a besieged place's last ward.

name: Gallant Overthrow Banner
description: The court's end of a siege in which both tracks loose together so the last stone falls and the defence breaks.

name: Armmercy
description: Raise the beam on the plateau rock with an oath spoken over each timber.

name: Eclipse Slingpouch
description: Check the pin and its socket in the gale and swear it sound before the first throw.

name: Wise Longarm
description: Cut the beam's bearing into the rock in a line the whole crew can read.

name: Squall Tackle
description: Speak the oath word and loose the beam in the moment the wind pauses.

name: Volition Tackle
description: Wind the beam without letting the bearing drift under the push of the wind.

name: Sovereign Overthrow
description: Throw with the wind at the arm tip so the sling snaps out faster than in a calm swing.

name: Steelswing
description: Bind the oath and qi into the stone so it pierces the ward of a plateau foe.

name: Immovable Shortarm
description: Brace the beam with the crew's sworn qi so a sudden gust cannot twist it off its bearing.

name: Royal Heaveoff
description: Draw the crew's oath and qi into one winding and loose a stone that rides the wind across the plateau.

name: Unrivaled Entropy Whiplash
description: The school's throw in which an oath is spoken and the stone falls with the whole crew's sworn qi on the foe.

name: Parity Tackle
description: Set a stone on the plateau at each bearing so the line can be found again after any shift.

name: Pealarm
description: Stretch a rope along the bearing between two cairns and check the engine's line against it.

name: Merciful Ballast
description: Cut a notch in the frame that frames a distant peak on the bearing.

name: Bloom Rigging
description: Sweep the footing of the engine yard clear of the gravel the wind has blown in.

name: Prism Letgo
description: Loose on the held bearing so each stone falls in the same place whatever the wind has done.

name: Illustrious Counterswing
description: Aim by the notched peak so the line holds even when the crew's eyes are tired.

name: Compassionate Ballast
description: Return the engine to its marked line after each recoil with a few taps of a mallet.

name: Bloompulley
description: Shift the bearing by a marked cairn when the foe moves along the plateau without losing the line.

name: Sigilarm
description: Hold a bearing with a steady fall of stone that no force can cross without breaking its order.

name: Steelpulley
description: Put qi through the stone on the held bearing so it breaks the ward at the far end of the line.

name: Armbanner
description: Hold the bearing through a long winding then loose one stone that strikes exactly the marked place.

name: Statute Heaveoff
description: The school's fall in which the bearing is held unmoved so long that no enemy can cross it.

name: Solar Pullrope
description: Anchor the engine to open ground with buried timbers so no gale or throw can shift it.

name: Benevolent Rigging
description: Post a watcher on an open rise to track the enemy approach over the bare ground.

name: Tranquil Ballast
description: Coil every rope in the order it will be needed so the engine can be struck in a short time.

name: Tackleverdict
description: Loose with the gale across open ground so the stone carries beyond the reach of enemy archers.

name: Squallarm
description: Lob a quick mixed load at a skirmish line closing on the engine so the first ranks stagger.

name: Vigor Heaveoff
description: Form the crew in an open ring around the engine so each can run any way the foe comes.

name: Deluge Rigging
description: Draw the engine back along its bearing between throws so the foe's closing gains no ground.

name: Prismarm
description: Drive qi through a stone to split the ward of a charging champion on open ground.

name: Noble Shortarm
description: Whirl out a load of gravel so a gale of stones scours a broad stretch of open field.

name: Noble Fulcrum
description: Gather all remaining qi in the crew into one stone when the engine stands alone and loose it at the charge's leader.

name: Inferno Rigging
description: The school's throw for an engine with nothing to shelter behind a stone falling with the gale behind the crew's qi.

name: Parity Rigging
description: Plait the oath sling from wind-cured cord and tie one turn for each crewman who swears it.

name: Reminiscence Releasehook
description: Fix the eye on the bearing mark through the sling's swing and note when the cord draws taut.

name: Reminiscence Hangcradle
description: Cut a release mark in the rock where the cord ring should slip free on every throw.

name: Swing Crown
description: Let the sworn cord ring slip at its mark so the stone leaves true on its bearing.

name: Inferno Overthrow
description: Whip the cord along the held bearing so the stone flies out as the line draws it.

name: Pulleybenison
description: Retune the sling's length after each gust by a knot's width so the release stays true.

name: Radiance Counterswing
description: Fill the shot with qi through the sworn cord so it breaks the ward at the end of the bearing.

name: Demolition Whiplash
description: Release a mixed load on the held bearing so a rain of stones falls along its whole line.

name: Pulsar Overthrow
description: Draw the crew's oath through the sling in one long winding and loose a stone far along the bearing.

name: Paramount Quenched Counterswing
description: The school's throw in which the sworn sling releases once so the stone keeps its bearing to the end.

name: Tranquil Pullrope
description: Pin the engine frame to the plateau rock with iron so a storm gale cannot move a timber.

name: Revelation Shortarm
description: Read the gathering cloud over the plateau to know when the storm will break.

name: Parity Fulcrum
description: Gather hail-sized stones in a sheltered pile for a throw that must fly in the storm.

name: Slingpouch Largesse
description: Soak the sling through before the storm so rain cannot change its weight midway.

name: Pulleydecree
description: Release in a storm gust so its force adds to the arm's own sweep.

name: Gallant Fulcrum
description: Raise the aim to allow for the weight of rain on the stone and sling.

name: Luminous Hangcradle
description: Wind the beam in each lull of the storm and hold the pawl through the next burst.

name: Thunderous Counterswing
description: Count the beats between thunder claps and loose on the one that gives the engine its steadiest moment.

name: Pulleyverdict
description: Pour the crew's qi into the stone so it flies through the storm and breaks a ward.

name: Demolition Ballast
description: Fling a mixed load so it joins the hail and falls across a broad stretch of the field.

name: Letgobanner
description: Wind the beam through a whole storm's lull and loose a stone that rides the wind to the far ranks.

name: Dauntless Swing Triumph
description: The school's throw in which the crew's qi and the storm's wind together drive a stone down on the foe.

name: Tackle Gift
description: Bed the engine in the plateau rock so deeply that a gale throw does not move a pin.

name: Solar Rigging
description: Cycle the breath with the winding so the crew's qi rises as the beam descends.

name: Longarm Benison
description: Hang a gauge flag that reads the gale's force by how many of its folds stand out.

name: Prism Heaveoff
description: Count the gale's beats and loose the engine on every third so the throw keeps pace with the wind.

name: Armbenison
description: Warm the arm with core qi so the beam answers a hair faster on the heave.

name: Vigor Tackle
description: Wind the beam again the instant the throw leaves so there is never a pause between stones.

name: Pulleybanner
description: Slide the bearing a mark at a time between throws so the fall walks along the foe's line.

name: Radiance Ballast
description: Drive core qi into the stone so it keeps its force through the gale and breaks a ward at the end.

name: Grand Overthrow
description: Chain three throws in one unbroken count so the second and third land in the dust of the first.

name: Prism Releasehook
description: Hold the engine through a very long winding of core qi and loose a stone that crosses the whole field.

name: Seasonarm
description: The school's fall in which the engine throws stone after stone with no pause until the ground cannot be held.
